subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one - word substitute for the given phrase.

One who lends money to others at a very high rate of interest.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Usurer**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Usurer"** means a person who lends money at unreasonably high rates of interest. (सूदखोर)

 
 
• **Example: **He was known as a usurer because he charged exorbitant interest rates on the loans he provided.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct one-word substitute for the given phrase is **'Usurer'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Usurer**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Curator **(संग्रहालयाध्यक्ष): A person in charge of a museum, library, etc.

 
 
• **Example:** The curator organized an impressive exhibit on ancient Egyptian artifacts.
 
 
 
• **Bankrupt **(दिवालिया): A person who is unable to pay their debts.
 
 
• **Example: **The company went bankrupt after the economic downturn.
 
 
 
• **Numismatist** (मुद्राशास्त्री): A person who collects or studies coins, paper money, and medals.
 
 
• **Example:** The numismatist had an impressive collection of ancient coins.
